map.Childhood Asthma Control Test (C-ACT, 4-: Childhood Asthma Control Test (C-ACT 4-11 yr) / ACT (≥12 yr) to assess asthma control over the past 4 weeks
map.提示：C-ACT适用于4-11岁儿童(7道题由儿童自答+家长答)，ACT适用于≥: Note: C-ACT is for 4-11 yr (7 items: child self + parent); ACT for ≥12 yr. Assess past 4 weeks. Long-term goal: achieve and maintain control, prevent attacks, keep normal lung function. ICS (inhaled corticosteroids) is first-line controller. Acute PEF <60% predicted needs care. This tool is for clinical reference, not a substitute for professional evaluation.
map.满分 25→控制良好，维持当前阶梯，3 月复评。: Full 25 -> well controlled, maintain current step, re-evaluate in 3 months.
map.19–22 分→部分控制，升阶梯并查吸入技术。: 19-22 -> partly controlled, step up and check inhaler technique.
map.4–11 岁，儿童自答+家长观察结合，更敏感。: 4-11 yr, child self-report + parent observation combined, more sensitive.
map.≥20 控制、13–19 部分、≤12 未控制，指导升降级。: ≥20 controlled, 13-19 partly, ≤12 uncontrolled, guides step up/down.
map.关于「哮喘(儿童)控制测试器」: About the Childhood Asthma Control Test Tool
map.儿童哮喘控制测试器(C-ACT/ACT)，评估4-11岁和12岁以上儿童哮喘控制: The childhood asthma control tool (C-ACT/ACT) assesses control in 4-11 yr and ≥12 yr children and guides treatment adjustment. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
